perks.name: Fragile Focus
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus range until your shield is destroyed. The bonus returns once your shield has regenerated to full strength.

perks.name: Perpetual Motion
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and reload speed while the wielder is in motion.

perks.name: Pugilist
perks.desc:
Final blows with this weapon generate melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

perks.name: Dynamic Sway Reduction
perks.desc: Improves accuracy and stability while continuously holding down the trigger.

perks.name: Enlightened Action
perks.desc: Dealing damage improves reload speed and handling.

perks.name: Slice
perks.desc: Casting your class ability allows this weapon to sever targets on hit for a brief duration, up to a maximum number of targets.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Tear
perks.desc: Precision final blows cause nearby targets to become severed.

perks.name: Ambitious Assassin
perks.desc: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.

perks.name: Strategist
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon generate class ability energy. Activating your class ability briefly improves this weapon's stability.

perks.name: Firefly
perks.desc: Precision kills with this weapon increase reload speed and cause the target to explode, dealing Solar damage to nearby enemies.

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.desc: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

perks.name: Target Lock
perks.desc: Damage increases the longer this weapon remains on a target.

perks.name: Chaos Reshaped
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus damage while in combat for an extended time. Remaining in combat for even longer rewards a larger damage bonus and periodically heals the wielder.

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.

perks.name: Hatchling
perks.desc: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location.

perks.name: Binary Orbit
perks.desc: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for a short duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Paracausal Affinity
perks.desc: Final blows of energy types matching this weapon's alignment grant increased damage for a short period of time. Light final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Darkness final blows boost Stasis and Strand weapons.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 111 from 30 July 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/4KO3Yr8AkPRBgKlNmacrGS?si=6dfa9e466dde41a0) with @Saint_Kabr, @ImpetusAlways and @CourtProjects (PvE / PvE-MinorSpec / PvE-EndGame / PvE-God / M+KB / Controller): First-choice PvE pick for add-clearing minor enemies in end-game actives. Shapeable. Base stats are okay by comparison to its peers and equate to 17.24m ADS range before damage dropoff, 0.23s ADS speed, 0.31s ready and 0.27s stow speed, and 2.17s reload speed. Even if you hit 100 recoil, it's still tough to control on controller, so look to boost stability with your barrel and mag perks - a little extra reload speed never hurts too. For end-game use, you're looking for traits that don't need a kill to proc, so in the first column Perpetual Motion, and Enlightened Action (more for the reload than the handling boost) work. In the second, Desperate Measures is the best damage perk - grenade and melee kills are easy with Prismatic for up to a +30% boost. The Collective Purpose origin trait only works in a fireteam, but offers small boosts to range and handling, which is always useful. Recommended MW: Stability or Reload Speed, with a Backup Mag mod.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 111 from 30 July 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/4KO3Yr8AkPRBgKlNmacrGS?si=6dfa9e466dde41a0) with @Saint_Kabr, @ImpetusAlways and @CourtProjects (PvE / PvE-MinorSpec / PvE-God / M+KB / Controller): First-choice PvE pick for add-clearing minor enemies in end-game actives, particularly with ability-focussed builds. Shapeable. Base stats are okay by comparison to its peers and equate to 17.24m ADS range before damage dropoff, 0.23s ADS speed, 0.31s ready and 0.27s stow speed, and 2.17s reload speed. Even if you hit 100 recoil, it's still tough to control on controller, so look to boost stability with your barrel and mag perks - a little extra reload speed never hurts too. You have the choice of both Demolitionist and Pugilist in the first trait column so, if you're building around grenade or melee abilities, you'll be able to recover ability energy quickly. pairing well in the second, Desperate Measures is the best damage perk - grenade and melee kills are easy with Prismatic too - for up to a +30% boost. The Collective Purpose origin trait only works in a fireteam, but offers small boosts to range and handling, which is always useful. Recommended MW: Stability or Reload Speed, with a Backup Mag mod.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 111 from 30 July 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/4KO3Yr8AkPRBgKlNmacrGS?si=6dfa9e466dde41a0) with @Saint_Kabr, @ImpetusAlways and @CourtProjects (PvE / PvE-Utility / PvE-God / M+KB / Controller): First-choice PvE pick for a Bait and Switch rotation weapon end-game actives, particularly with ability-focussed builds. Shapeable. Base stats are okay by comparison to its peers and equate to 17.24m ADS range before damage dropoff, 0.23s ADS speed, 0.31s ready and 0.27s stow speed, and 2.17s reload speed. Even if you hit 100 recoil, it's still tough to control on controller, so look to boost stability with your barrel and mag perks - a little extra reload speed never hurts too. If you want a primary to use in a boss damage phase, particularly on Hunter, then Slice will sever after a dodge reload, for -40% damage reduction to outgoing boss damage. While you're not going to be using this as your primary damage option, Chaos Reshaped should be procced while stowed for both stacks, so you should get the +35% damage and maybe a burst of healing when you use it with a Bait and Switch heavy weapon. The Collective Purpose origin trait only works in a fireteam, but offers small boosts to range and handling, which is always useful. Recommended MW: Stability or Reload Speed, with a Backup Mag mod.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Imminence with Chaos Reshaped or Firefly will be a weapon to bring to any activity. Chaos Reshaped is better for Onslaught type activities where the fighting barely stops, while Firefly will be better room to room like in a strike or story mission with downtime. Perpetual Motion and Enlightened Action both allow you to have faster reloads depending on moving or hitting things." Recommended MW: Stability.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "While lightweight frames are good for the faster mobility / dodge cooldown this one in particular can hold its own outside of being a good frame for the crucible. Dynamic Sway Reduction and Kill Clip are incredible for dueling and kill chaining together. I would like to see someone try and keep Chaos Reshaped up but I don’t think outside of top tier players it would come into play. Staying alive and in combat for that long is just difficult to do." Recommended MW: Range.
